about: The latest installment in the GBVS series is taking the genre to new heights! Rise to glory in the definitive fighting game experience for beginners and veterans alike.
It's a Party! Claim Your Crown in Grand Bruise Legends!
Need a break from matches? Take a breather and experience a one-of-a-kind island lobby filled with fun attractions.
You can even go head-to-head with other players online in a variety of obstacle courses and survival games in an all-new party mode, Grand Bruise Legends!
(Avatar, character, and mode availability is limited in the Free Edition.)

Stay Focused on the Battle, Not the Controls Newcomers can fully enjoy the intensity and thrills of one-on-one combat without needing to memorize complicated controls—simple inputs can be used to perform skills with the press of a single button!
summary: Forge your glory in the flames of battle.
